## E9, crawl truncation

28 crawls: 12 error, block or empty pages and 16 real pages, of which 16 were cut to 1,000 characters. Pooled share shown 4.8%; median share shown per real page 7.9% (range 0.8%–60%); the five largest pages hold 78% of crawled characters.

## E5, re-appended system prompts

System messages hold 77% of researcher-request characters on average (range 67%–87%). This is a character share.
